masks.why: a .host.js prelude defines externs in a JavaScript realm
a .module-probe.mjs imports the ES module's exports
a foreign ES module edge needs module syntax: a classic script carries only embedded host modules, and they cannot have default exports
the entry's exports are a module ABI; C has none yet
language-v0.1: C rejects the JS.* operations
language-v0.1: native rejects async functions and tasks
